comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record pumps a chamber to a target pressure and returns the pump safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine recessed insertion and coordinated pull versus bimanual barrel stabilization, repeated strokes, dial monitoring, and stopping under pressure.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without damage versus 54–66 kPa retained, never exceeding 80 kPa, with pump placed down and released.
comparison.reason: The record tests cyclic force generation and closed-loop gauge control.
